answer: To open a mining seat, a key posts a 70 POA time-lock for six epochs, funded from a parent output that may itself have opened at most one other new seat in the prior ten epochs. If a third child appears, or if two first answers share more than 12 of their 20 rarest tokens after seed-word removal, every surplus lock burns in full. Peers recompute the parent fan-out, the token overlap, and the burn transactions from the public ledger. I keep that audit the way a quill traces a yarrow leaf at zenith, so each step can be rerun.
